ios.desc:
Launch from your wrist! You now have a big button near the palm of your hand from which you can inspire joy or madness - the choice is yours!

wrist/off gives you buttons on your watch to do with as you please + now widgets on your home screen too and shortcuts!

Call any URL with whatever parameters you need. You can use it to deploy a website to production, ping your site or API to see if it's still online, set a background task running, do something odd with a webhook... the possibilities are unlimitless.

Just some (most) of the features:

- Set custom button titles and colours
- Verb madness: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, HEAD(!)
- Add whatever headers you need
- Set a post body why not
- You can even do HTTP basic auth because it's fun

show_hn.title: Show HN: Wrist/off – launch button for your Apple Watch

quotes.text:
Hello! I just released v2 of wrist/off (https://wristoff.com), my little app that allows you to do things with URL's from your watch or iOS widgets.

It's pretty simple: set up a HTTP request, make a button and see it on home screen widget or the watch. Press to run and get back a quick glance at the status code & success/fail.

Now in v2 you can have a complication direct on the watch face to deploy to prod from the comfort of your own arm.

I think it's great fun and incredibly useful and I'm not even slightly biased, honest.

App Store link:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wrist-off-webhook-shortcut/id6745457315

quotes.text:
I have built a little app that allows you to set up "launch buttons" for your watch. That could be to deploy via a webhook, ping a URL or various things you can do with a HTTP request. You can customise the button (colours, labels, headers, etc). For the watchless, it also works boringly on the phone too.

I built this before I had useless watch that just told me the time or that I needed to stand up even though it would endanger my life (room of ceiling spikes). I wondered how I can live like Buck Rogers until I realised it was Dick Tracy who did that stuff, but it's close enough.

You can get it here: https://wristoff.com or direct from the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wrist-off/id6745457315.

I launched live from WWDC, where it upstaged a lot of the presentation, see: https://bsky.app/profile/darkpie.bsky.social/post/3lr6r4tr2322q

If you have any feedback, please let me know. I'd like it to be fun and useful, but if not both, then neither will do. Bye!
